name: Vega Neutral
description: This keyword returns the quantity of selected instrument required to make net vega of all positions in the strategy of selected underlying to zero. Returns quantity in multiple of the lot size of Instrument as float
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the quantity of selected instrument required to make net vega of all positions in the strategy of selected underlying to zero. Returns quantity in multiple of the lot size of Instrument as float

This keyword is usually used in QTY FX in position builder
